name: array-missing-comma
rule: Array elements must be separated by a comma.

name: basic-string-unescaped-newline
rule: A basic string may not contain a literal newline.

name: basic-string-unknown-escape-e
rule: TOML 1.0.0 has no \e escape; the basic-string escape set is fixed.

name: basic-string-unknown-escape-x
rule: TOML 1.0.0 has no \xHH escape; the basic-string escape set is fixed.

name: bool-titlecase
rule: Booleans must be lowercase true or false.

name: datetime-missing-seconds
rule: TOML 1.0.0 date-times require seconds (HH:MM:SS).

name: dotted-key-turns-scalar-into-table
rule: A key already defined as a value cannot be redefined as a table by a dotted key.

name: duplicate-key
rule: A key may not be defined more than once in the same table.

name: empty-bare-key
rule: A key/value pair must have a key.

name: empty-value
rule: A key/value pair must have a value.

name: float-leading-dot
rule: A float must have at least one digit before the decimal point.

name: float-trailing-dot
rule: A float must have at least one digit after the decimal point.

name: inline-table-extend-outside
rule: An inline table is closed once defined and cannot be extended.

name: inline-table-newline
rule: TOML 1.0.0 inline tables must be written on a single line.

name: inline-table-trailing-comma
rule: TOML 1.0.0 inline tables may not have a trailing comma.

name: integer-leading-zero
rule: Integers may not have leading zeros.

name: integer-overflow-int64
rule: Integer is outside the range of a 64-bit signed integer.

name: integer-underscore-adjacent
rule: An integer underscore must sit between digits and not be adjacent to another underscore.

name: local-time-missing-seconds
rule: TOML 1.0.0 local times require seconds (HH:MM:SS).

name: quoted-equivalent-duplicate-key
rule: A bare key and its quoted equivalent denote the same key and may not both be defined.

name: table-after-dotted-key-defined
rule: A table header cannot redefine a table already established by a dotted key.

name: table-redefined
rule: A table may not be defined more than once.
